_doc: [ui2] Workbench tabs appear only once they are open (the owner: don't show what you can't use yet). A tab opens when ANY of its conditions holds, and stays open for good (flags.bench_tabs). Conditions: ["earned", N] lifetime cubes earned; ["stat", key, N] GameState.stats[key] >= N; ["hub_level", N]; ["flag", key]; ["always"]; ["builds"] something to build or built (HubBuilds, [ui3]). rockets is not a tab any more: it sets when the Upgrades tab shows its Rocket section. Other systems can add a gate in code: UpgradesScreen.set_tab_gate(id, func() -> bool, hint), which wins over this table.
